WHY_THIS_EXISTS: a file was added to TLMR01/code AFTER the master freeze was taken. The freeze is not re-taken and not amended, because a freeze that moves once the run has begun is no freeze. Instead the addition is declared here and every frozen file is re-hashed to prove nothing frozen moved.
WHAT_THE_ADDITION_IS: tlmr01_analysis_fixture.py — a TEST. It builds synthetic per-world dictionaries with hand-checkable answers and runs the frozen aggregation, the exact intervals, the support rule, the world-clustered bootstrap, the eligibility clauses and the disposition cascade against them. It reads no archive and sees no outcome, so it cannot inform any rule.
